products.name: Harvester CSA Membership
products.description:
The Harvester is our premier tier CSA Membership. Harvesters are committed to buying most of their groceries through FFCSA, spending an average of $125/week on the Farm Store.  


Your $500 subscription includes:

  • Access to all products in the Farm Store for weekly, bi-weekly or monthly orders
  • Your choice of FREE Bounty items. When we have an abundant bounty of something, we'll add these as free add-ons to the Farm Store
  • Weekly newsletter with farm updates, product sales and recipes
  • Member only discounts at farmers markets for Deck Family Farm products
  • A free Deck Family Farm tote bag and t-shirt in your first share
  • Two free tickets to annual dinner
  • One FREE farmer's choice Pick of the Pasture item every month
  • Free home delivery on all orders for members in Corvallis, Junction City, Eugene and Springfield

When you join our farmily as a Full Farm CSA member, you are committing to a minimum 6-month subscription. Your monthly contribution amount will be charged every 30 days and credits will be issued to your Local Line account. You use these credits to shop and any unused credits from one month will roll over to the next month. While we do not refund unused store credits, we encourage you to use your available credits on food items or to donate to our feed-a-friend program. Food purchases above and beyond your subscription balance will be billed to your stored payment method.


Purchasing products through the Full Farm CSA requires you to agree to our membership agreement.

products.description: The "Canada Gold" (or AAC Canada Gold-Dorée) isa newly released, highly-rated yellow potato variety bred in Canada. Often considered an improved, modern alternative to the classic Yukon Gold, it boasts superior flavor, better disease resistance, and higher yields.

products.name: Walla Walla Onions
products.description: Walla Walla onions are prized for their consistently sweet and mild flavor when raw, and due to their high sugar and water content, they develop a deep, sweet, and warm flavor profile when cooked.

products.name: Butternut Squash
products.description: Butternut squash is a pear-shaped, creamy-tan winter squash with a long neck and a hard, edible skin that is often peeled. It has a sweet and nutty flavor, dense orange flesh, and a small seed cavity in the bulbous end, making it versatile for cooking. Its flesh becomes tender and creamy when roasted and is also good pureed for soups or used in baked goods.

products.name: Green Curly Kale
products.description: Curly leafed kale is probably the first thing that comes to mind when you think of kale. The bright-green leaves are sometimes curled so tightly it can be hard to chop them. This kind of kale tends to have a bright, peppery flavor that can become quite bitter.

products.name: Asparagus
products.description: With it's bright green color and earthy flavor with a hint of sweetness, asparagus is rich in Vitamin C to help support a healthy immune system.

products.name: Paste Tomatoes
products.description: Paste varieties include : Oxheart & Northern Ruby. Paste tomatoes, also known as plum tomatoes, are characterized by their meaty, low-moisture, and low-seed content, making them ideal for making tomato paste, sauces, and canning. They have an elongated shape, unlike round slicing tomatoes, and are known for their ability to cook down into a thick, rich concentrate.

products.name: Green Mizuna
products.description: Mizuna, also known as Japanese mustard greens, is a nutrient-rich leafy green offering numerous health benefits, including being a good source of vitamins A, C, and K, antioxidants, and fiber, supporting immune health, digestion, and bone health.

products.name: Broccoli Greens
products.description: Just the greens, great for salads!

products.name: Purple and Green Broccolini
products.description: Broccoli has a slightly bittersweet flavor and thick, meaty stems. Broccolini is milder and sweeter than broccoli, with firm, crunchy stems, and leafy florets.

products.name: Oxheart Heirloom Tomatoes
products.description: Cour Di Bue, one of the 6 best tomatoes in the World.

products.name: Ho mi Zi (asian mustard heads)
products.description: Ho Mi Zi, also known as Dragon Tongue Mustard, is a variety of Brassica juncea, a type of Asian mustard. It's characterized by its green and purple crinkled leaves with thick white midribs. Young leaves are tender and delicious raw in salads, while mature leaves offer a spicy-sweet flavor suitable for stir-fries.

products.name: Green  Butterhead Lettuce
products.description: Butterhead lettuce is a soft, tasty lettuce variation that gets its name thanks to its buttery flavor! Many consider it similar to cabbage as its shape and color (often coming in red) make them look quite alike. Some even refer to it as cabbage lettuce!

products.name: Honeynut Squash
products.description: Honeynut squash is a winter squash cultivar bred from butternut and buttercup squash. It has a similar shape and flavor to butternut squash but averages about half the size and is significantly sweeter. It has dark tan to orange skin and orange fleshy pulp.

products.name: Celery
products.description: Celery is both mild and strong in flavor. Watery, but also salty in an unusual way with a lingering bitterness. It has a green sort of taste, similar in the way spinach does. Great raw or cooked, in vegetable stock and enhancing soup! Grown by: Groundwork Organic Farm

products.name: Butternut Squash
products.description: A type of winter squash that grows on a vine. It has a sweet, nutty taste similar to that of a pumpkin. It has tan-yellow skin and orange fleshy pulp with a compartment of seeds in the blossom end. Try it roasted, or turn into pasta!

products.name: Crimini Mushrooms
products.description: Cremini mushrooms (also spelled "crimini") are Agaricus Bisporus mushrooms, which is actually the same type of mushroom as white mushrooms and portobellos, the only difference being their stage of maturity. Cremini mushrooms have a mild, earthy flavor and a meaty texture. Grown by Yamhill located in Yamhill OR

products.name: Red Cherry Tomatoes
products.description: Cherry tomatoes taste similar to other fresh tomatoes, but because of their small size, the flavor can be a little more concentrated. Bright and sweet, they have a thin, snappy peel and a very juicy center- a balance of sweet and tart.

products.name: Castlefranco Chicory Head
products.description: Heirloom vegetable from Italy. Can be eaten raw in a salad, cooked as a green, sauteed, braised, baked on pizza, cooked in risottos- the list goes on!

products.name: Fresh Chives
products.description: Fresh chives are a culinary herb known for their mild, onion-like flavor and vibrant green color. They are a versatile addition to various dishes, offering a subtle, savory taste and a fresh visual appeal.

products.name: Cayenne Pepper
products.description: A thin chili pepper, green to red in color, about 2 to 5 inches long. The "cayenne pepper" spice you use mostly in pizza restaurants is the dried, ground version of this pepper. Scoville Heat Units: 30,000 - 50,000 SHU.

products.name: Green Cabbage
products.description: Serve cabbage raw as a crunchy coleslaw, braised on the stove for a meaty stew, roasted in the oven, cooked in the slow cooker, or even grilled like a steak. Cabbage doesn't always get the appreciation it deserves.

products.name: Delfino Cilantro
products.description: Delfino cilantro, also known as Confetti Cilantro, is a unique variety of cilantro known for its finely cut, fern-like leaves that resemble dill or carrot tops. It offers a more delicate and subtle flavor compared to traditional cilantro, making it suitable for garnishing and infusing. This variety is also known for its slow-bolting characteristics, meaning it takes longer to flower and produce seeds, extending the harvest window

products.name: Crisphead Lettuce
products.description: Crisphead lettuce, more commonly known as iceberg, forms a tight firm head of crisp leaves. It has a crunchy 'CRISP' texture and mild flavor. Perfect for wedge salads - cherry tomatoes, bacon, blue cheese and lots of pepper!

products.name: Padron Peppers
products.description: Similar to shishito peppers, not every Padron will give you some heat. They range from 500 to 2,000 Scoville heat units. If you happen to bite into one that's on the upper end of the Scoville scale, it'll rank about half as hot as a jalapeo. This gamble is part of their appeal.

products.name: Delicata Squash
products.description: Also known as sweet potato squash for its brown sugar flavor, delicata tastes like a cross between fresh corn and pumpkin pie. Great roasted and made into pasta!

products.name: Dill
products.description: Dill can be eaten raw or cooked. To use fresh dill, cut the leaves away from the stem and remove the stem. Dill is commonly paired with salmon, lemon and chicken, dishes with spinach, and sprinkled over roasted potatoes. It pairs with creamy sauces made with yogurt or other dairy products.

products.name: Lions Mane Mushrooms
products.description: Lion's mane mushrooms can be enjoyed raw, cooked, dried or steeped as a tea. Many describe their flavor as “seafood-like,” often comparing it to crab or lobster.

products.name: Edible Calendula Flower
products.description: Spruce up your meal with a pint of edible flowers - great for garnish! Use homeopathically in a salve.

products.name: Pickling Cucumber
products.description: These picklers get chubby quick, but retain great flavor as they grow so you may get a range of sizes. You don't have to pickle picklers. Harvested young, when the seed cavities are small, any variety of pickler is fine for fresh eating in a salad or out of hand. Pickler varieties aren't uniformly dark green like the slicing-type cucumbers sold in the supermarket. They are paler green, sometimes with light-colored stripes running lengthwise down the fruit. Picklers have thinner skin and crisper, crunchier flesh than most slicers.

products.name: Fava Beans
products.description:
Add them to pasta and toss into salads -- green salads, macaroni salads, sauteed greens salads, you name it!

They are also excellent drizzled with dressing and tossed with goat cheese!

Plan on 1 lb of beans per serving!

products.name: Fennel
products.description: Uncooked fennel has a mild licorice flavor and a crunchy texture. When cooked it becomes more delicate and the texture softens. Sautee, braise or bake! Use in soups and stews, or slice up raw and garnish your salads. About 1 pound.

products.name: French Breakfast Radish
products.description: Similar appearance to the familiar cherry belle radish but instead of a bulbous shape, it is elongated with edible leafy greens on top. The French breakfast radish has a mild peppery flavor and crisp texture. It is often eaten raw but the radish can be cooked as well.

products.name: Parsnips
products.description: Root vegetable closely related to carrots and parsley! Best when cooked but can be eaten raw. Flavor is starchy like a potato, sweet like carrots, and bitter similar to turnips.

products.name: Sage
products.description: Sage has a pronounced herbal flavor that is earthy, slightly peppery taste with hints of mint, eucalyptus, and lemon. It works well in heavier dishes with rich ingredients that can hold their own against such a bold flavor.

products.name: Banana Shallots
products.description: French Echalion Shallots, also known as Banana Shallots are full-flavored, and because of their long shape, they cook quickly and are very easy to peel. French Echalion (Banana) Shallots are covered with a thin, paper-like skin that can range from pale brown or light gray to a soft rose.

products.name: Portabella Mushrooms
products.description: Deep meat-like texture and flavor. Portabellas hearty flavor makes them suitable for meat subsitutes- grill them up and serve them as "burgers."

products.name: Fresh Thyme
products.description:
Lush spring and ideal culinary thyme. Thyme has an earthy, minty, slightly lemony flavor. Used fresh or dried, and works well in soups, roasted vegetables, pasta, sauces, pizzas and more!


From- Red Tail Growers

products.name: Fresno Peppers
products.description: Fresno peppers look like jalapeno peppers however the Fresno pepper has a fruitier, smokier taste and they are a bit spicier. In fact, they measure from 2,500 - 10,000 Scoville Heat Units (SHU).

products.name: Garlic Scapes
products.description: Garlic scapes are the tender stem and flower bud of a hardneck garlic plant. (Hardneck garlic is the kind of garlic that typically grows in Canada and the northeastern U.S.) Scapes first grow straight out of the garlic bulb, then coil. When harvested, they look like long, curly green beans.

products.name: Frisee Lettuce
products.description: Also called curly endive, frisee grows in a head like other greens. The leaves are green on the outside and paler and more yellow on the inside. The leaves resemble ferns, with a lot of forking, giving it a frizzy or curly appearance. The leaves of frisee can be cooked, but they are more often used raw in salads.

products.name: Green Bell Pepper
products.description: Green bell pepper is a sweet pepper picked before ripening from a plant belonging to the Solanaceae family. As it ripens, the fruit turns yellow, orange, and then red. However, there are bell pepper varieties that remain green when fully ripened. Green bell peppers are low in calories, and high in dietary fiber and vitamins C and K. They are slightly bitter, which accentuates their refreshing flavor when eaten raw. They are also eaten cooked, particularly in ratatouille.

products.name: Red Onion
products.description: Sharp and spicy in flavor. Used raw in salads. Soaking them in water will make them extra crisp and rid them of some of that fierce flavor. Great grilled, pickled, in tacos, and on pizza.

products.name: Green Little Gem
products.description: Little Gem' is an English heirloom that is a small variety of romaine, but has the succulent sweetness of butterhead lettuce.

products.name: Red Bell Peppers
products.description: Red bell peppers are one of the common colors of mature bell peppers. They're blocky with three to four lobes and have crisp, juicy flesh with a sweet flavor.

products.name: Green Romaine Lettuce
products.description: A type of head lettuce that is typically deep green with elongated leaves. Known for its mild flavor and crisp texture, it has sturdy leaves that make it more tolerant to heat than other lettuce varieties. High in minerals, such as calcium, phosphorous, magnesium, and potassium. It's naturally low in sodium. Plus, romaine lettuce is packed with vitamin C, vitamin K, and folate. It's a good source of beta carotene, which converts into vitamin A in the body.

products.name: Green Tomatoes
products.description: Green tomatoes can be used for pickling, frying, jam or chutney.

products.name: Green Scallions
products.description: Both the green and white parts of the scallion are edible: the green has a milder flavor and makes an attractive garnish. Generally, the white part of the scallion is sharper tasting, or more onion-y, and is used when it will be cooked.

products.name: Shiitake Mushrooms
products.description: The stems of the shiitake mushroom are stringier and harder than the cap, and you can cut off the bottom half of the stem - or the entire stem - to make the mushrooms easier to eat. Slice the mushrooms into thin strips and scatter them over a salad or a plate of fresh nachos for extra nutrition and a boost in flavor. Grown by CK Fiber in Creswell OR

products.name: Sweet Salad Turnips
products.description: Though they are most commonly cooked, turnips can be enjoyed raw too! If you plan to eat them raw, simply peel and slice the turnip like an apple to eat with dips or add to the top of your salad. Be sure to slice off the root end and remove the greens – which can be saved for cooking as well. Mildly spicy when raw, turnips turn sweet, nutty, and earthy when cooked. This goes for texture, too: raw turnips have a crisp, starchy flesh.

products.name: Hungarian Hot Wax Pepper
products.description: Medium Spice. Great for pickling or making pepper sauce. The heat of the Hungarian wax pepper ranges from a mild 1,000 Scoville units to a spicy 15,000

products.name: Shallots
products.description: Shallots have a delicate and sweet flavor with a hint of sharpness, while onions bring a more intense heat. You can substitute shallots in nearly any recipe that calls for onions just make sure you're using the same volume. (For example, several medium shallots equals about one small yellow onion.)

products.name: Purple Bell Peppers
products.description: Purple bell peppers offer a unique combination of visual appeal and a flavor profile that is a bit less sweet and more earthy than other bell peppers, with a crisp texture that makes them ideal for raw applications like salads and garnishes. They contain anthocyanins, the same antioxidant compounds that give blueberries their color and contribute to a host of health benefits. When cooked, their vibrant purple color fades to green, so they are best enjoyed raw or lightly cooked to preserve their beautiful hue.

products.name: Herb Bundle: Rosemary, Thyme and Sage Combo
Fresh Oregano
products.description: A subtle balance between sweet and spicy, the flavor of oregano is bold and earthy with a slight bitterness that's reminiscent of the aromatic organic compound camphor. This unique flavor is due to the rich variety of essential oils within oregano, including pinene, limonene, thymol, and carvacrol.

products.name: Sunchokes
products.description: The white flesh of Sunchokes are nutty, sweet and crunchy like chestnuts when raw. Baked in their skins, they become more like potatoes with a mild taste of artichoke hearts. Sunchokes can be served raw, roasted, fried, pureed into soups, or steamed. Grown by: Gathering Together Farm in Philomath OR

products.name: Jalapeño Peppers
products.description: Jalapeo peppers have a vegetal flavor similar to a green bell pepper and a front-of-mouth heat effect. The spiciness can vary widely among individual peppers. Jalapenos are picked green and generally used in this unripened state. Jalapenos turn red as they ripen, both on and off the plant. They usually fall in the range of 2,000 to 8,000 Scoville Heat Units (SHU), which sounds like a lot, but it really isn't!

products.name: Pea Shoots
products.description: These iconic Spring-y greens are a multi-purpose delight! Eat them raw (and share with your cats!) on their own, or added to a salad or smoothie! You can also lightly sautee them with some lemon juice, salt, and pepper for a quick, light side of greens!

products.name: Sugar Snap Peas
products.description: Crunchy Sugar Snap Peas. Perfect for snacking!

products.name: Candy Sweet Onion
products.description: Sweet onions contain less sulfur and more water than yellow, red and white onions. This makes the flavor mild, crisp and good for eating raw, stuffing (like you would a mushroom) and frying into onion rings.

products.name: Red Jimmy Nardello Peppers
products.description: These chile peppers have a mild, sweet, and fruity flavor when fresh that contains little to no heat. Jimmy Nardello peppers range from 0 to 100 Scoville Heat Units (SHU)

products.name: Poblano Peppers
products.description: Similar to a green bell pepper with a little more kick. Cooking poblanos mellows them even more, making them slightly sweet. Ripe poblanos are red and tend to be spicier than unripe, green peppers. They're often dried as ancho chiles, and they add a peppery, slightly smoky flavor to dishes. Poblano peppers are mildly spicy, measuring 1,000–1,5000 on the Scoville scale

products.name: Sugarloaf Chicory
products.description: Looks similar to romaine lettuce, but is distinctly more bitter in flavor. Great in salads, sliced thinly and eaten raw. Grown by: Boldly Grown Farm(WA)

products.name: Orange Kabocha Squash
products.description:

products.name: Bi-Color Corn
products.description: Bi-color corn is a sweet corn variety featuring a mix of both yellow and white kernels on the same cob. Taste Profile: It is known for a sweet, rich flavor that combines the sugary taste of white corn with the traditional flavor of yellow corn. According to community consensus on Quora , users agree that overall flavor depends more on freshness, specific variety, and cooking method than just the color alone.

products.name: Purple Onion
products.description: With a great pungent flavor this onion is best used in salads!

products.name: Kohlrabi Purple or Green
products.description: Excellent raw, sauteed or steamed. Sweet but peppery in flavor, a taste and texture similar to broccoli stems. High in fiber!

products.name: Sweet Italian Peppers
products.description: A mix of red and yellow sweet Italian peppers!

products.name: Purple Sprouting Broccoli
products.description: With a tender texture but a snappy bite, this broccoli offers a delicious nutty and peppery flavor.

products.name: Italian (Dino) Kale

When prepared properly, it's delicious cooked or raw, as an element in soups, and salads, and can even be baked until crispy for kale chips!

products.name: Rainbow Chard
products.description: The large leaves have a mild, earthly and slightly bitter flavor. The stalks have a crunch like that of celery, but a sweet flavor.

products.name: Red Butter-head Little Gem Lettuce

products.description: Hybrid pepper by crossing a Italian bullpepper and a bell pepper. Great for frying or eating raw in salads or with dips.

products.name: Orange Bell Pepper
products.description: Orange & red bell peppers are two of the common colors of mature bell peppers. They're blocky with three to four lobes and have crisp, juicy flesh with a sweet flavor. Grown by:River land Family Farm

products.name: Parsley
products.description: Italian flat leaf variety. Clean, peppery with a touch of earthiness in its flavor- great all arounder in the kitchen.

products.name: Green Zucchini
products.description:
Zucchini can be eaten in many ways, including raw or grilled, in salads or sandwiches, spiralized into noodles, or baked into bread.


Zucchini has many health benefits, including:

Digestion: Zucchini is high in fiber and water, which can help with digestion and prevent constipation. The soluble fiber in zucchini can also benefit the healthy bacteria in your gut.

Weight management:Zucchini is low in calories and high in fiber and water, which can help you feel full and control your appetite.

Diabetes:Zucchini is rich in vitamin B6, which may help regulate blood glucose and protect against diabetes. It also contains magnesium and zinc, which can help break down sugar in the body.

Heart health:Zucchini is high in potassium, a heart-healthy mineral. High-fiber diets, like those that include zucchini, can also improve heart health.

Eye health:Zucchini contains beta-carotene, a carotenoid that the body can convert into vitamin A. Vitamin A helps with cell development in the eyes, which can improve vision and prevent age-related conditions like macular degeneration. Zucchini can also reduce swelling around the eyes.

Cancer prevention:Zucchini contains zeaxanthin and other compounds that may help prevent oxidative stress, which could reduce the risk of developing cancer.

products.name: Savoy Cabbage

About 1-2 Lbs

products.name: Shishito Frying Pepper
products.description: Shishitos are bright, flavorful sweet chilies with typically mild spiciness. There's a fiery punch every so often where a shishito breaks the norm and turns up the dial. products.description: Sweeter and crisper than a turnip, but tastes reminiscent of broccoli or cabbage. Excellent raw, sauteed or steamed!

products.name: Red Slicer Tomatoes
products.description: Slicer varieties include : Big Beef & Perfect Rogue. products.name: Purple Scallions
products.description: The difference between scallions, green onions and spring onions is age or the time they grow before being harvested. products.name: Brown Teff Flour
products.description: Milled from the whole grain, grown in the Willamette Valley by Camas Country Mill. Teff is a fine grain - about the size of a poppy seed. Teff grows predominantly in Ethiopia and Eritrea, and thrives even in difficult climates. As such, it comprises the staple grain of their cuisines. The grain has a very mild, nutty flavor, and it packs a serious nutritional punch. Teff has an excellent balance of amino acids, and it is also high in protein, calcium, and iron. Ground into flour, teff is used to make the traditional bread, injera: a flat, pancake-like, fermented bread that complements the exotic spices found in the regional food. It can also be ground into flour to make an excellent gluten-free flour alternative, and can be used to make pie crusts, cookies, breads, and an assortment of other baked goods. Teff can also be eaten whole and steamed, boiled, or baked as a side dish or a main course.

products.name: Tomatillos
products.description: These little fruits (yep, they're fruits, just like tomatoes and cucumbers), sometimes called husk tomatoes, look like green, unripe tomatoes with a dry, leafy husk that wraps around the outside. Tomatillos have a slightly more acidic, slightly less sweet flavor than ripe and unripe tomatoes. Prepping a tomatillo is pretty straight forward. The husks can be easily removed with your hands and discarded. You’ll notice a sticky film on the surface, which will come off with a quick rinse under warm water. From here, you decide what you want to do with them. If you want to keep the flavor bright and play up their bracing acidity, use them raw. If you want to mellow out that acidity a bit and access the fruit's deeper, more savory qualities, cooking them—whether you're roasting or grilling them whole or chopping them for a saute—is the move.

products.name: Cauliflower
products.description:
Cauliflower has many health benefits, including:

Digestion:

A medium head of cauliflower contains almost 12 grams of fiber, which can help with digestion, bowel regularity, and feeding beneficial gut bacteria. Fiber can also slow digestion, which can help you feel full longer.

Weight loss:

Cauliflower is low in calories, with only 25 calories per cup, and it's also high in water.

Antioxidants:

Cauliflower contains high levels of antioxidants and anti-inflammatory compounds, which can help prevent diseases like cancer, heart disease, and brain disease.

Immunity:

Vitamin C in cauliflower can help protect the body from infection and reduce inflammation that can cause disease.

Brain health:

Cauliflower contains choline, a B vitamin that can help improve memory and learning by boosting cognitive function.

Bone health:

Cauliflower contains vitamin C, which helps produce collagen to protect bones and joints from inflammation, and vitamin K, which can help prevent bone loss.

Cardiovascular disease:

Cauliflower contains anti-inflammatory agents and minerals like zinc and potassium, which can help remove plaque from blood vessels and improve blood circulation, which can reduce the risk of cardiovascular disease.

products.name: Italian Frying Pepper
products.description:
The Italian "friggi friggi" pepper is more commonly known as friggitelli, or Italian frying peppers. They are mild, small, and slender peppers native to southern Italy, prized for their sweet flavor and thin skin that makes them ideal for frying. The name comes from the Italian verb friggere, meaning "to fry". 

Friggitelli have a slightly sweet, fruity, and mild flavor, with a low heat level of 100–500 on the Scoville scale. Some varieties are entirely heatless. The taste can have a pleasant, slightly bitter edge.

products.name: 1/4 Beef Side October Deposit
products.description: **This purchase does not have immediate delivery. You will be contacted in October about fulfillment. Please disregard the fulfillment date listed in the cart.** Side sales involve purchasing a quarter or half of an entire animal. That animal is still living when you place the order and will be harvested on the farm on October 1st , 2026. You get to request the cuts of meat and you store the whole purchase in your freezer. Click here for a helpful Guide to buying beef sides. Reservations required: Reservations for sides are secured by a non-refundable deposit of $200. Deposits are taken through our CSA store. These deposits will be applied to the final price when making your final payment. Final price established after slaughter date Cut and wrap fees are included in the price Customers designate how the product will be portioned Invoice is sent to customer and product released upon full payment Cost per pound: Beef - $10 per pound of hanging weight Deposit prices: Quarter Beef $200 (if you are shopping as a Guest your deposit will end up being $230 which will be applied to the final price) Estimated Final Price and Processed Weight: $875 for a quarter beef which results in around 87 pounds of meat, plus bones and organs. This is provided only to give an idea. Every animal is different. Why purchase your meat by the side? Purchasing sides is the least expensive, most environmentally sound, and most humane way of purchasing meat. The animal is allowed to spend its entire life on the farm without being shipped to a slaughterhouse. Animals are slaughtered in a gentle and humane manner on the farm by local ODA-certified butchers. The cost for processing in this manner is significantly less, and we pass that savings on to you. When can I order meat this way? You can place your order today by going into our CSA store and purchasing a deposit. Then, when the annual date comes around, we go to work on your order. How much product will I actually receive? Since you are purchasing a live animal, it is difficult to give an exact amount until the animal is sacrificed. The actual weight of the product you receive (processed weight) will be approximately 70% of the hanging weight. Hanging weight (which the butcher will provide to the farm) is the weight of a carcass after slaughter and removal of organs, head, and hide. The processed weight is less because it accounts for the removal of bones, fat, and water lost during the dry-aging process. The take-home weight is also influenced by the choices of cuts you choose. Will you want bone-in or boneless roasts? Will you choose bone-in rib steaks or boneless ribeyes? Porterhouse and T-bone steaks have the bones, but they become Kansas City strip steaks and filet mignon without them. These decisions affect that total. You are also purchasing the fat and bones, and you should request those, or not, from the butcher’s cut sheet. How do I store the product? The meat will be given to you frozen and it should be stored in the freezer. To estimate freezer space, plan on one paper grocery bag per 30lbs of product. What to expect when ordering by the side: First, purchase a "Side Deposit" in Full Farm CSA. Available to Guests, CSA Members and Herdshare members. This reserves the animal for the October 2026 butcher date. Deck Family Farm continues to raise the animal to finishing weight. We will contact the customer the day after the processing with a final invoice based on the hanging weight. Invoice will be due at that time. The customer will be given access to the 4Star cut sheet to request how the meat should be portioned (ground, steaks, roasts, etc.) When final customer payment is received, 4-Star can release the order to the customer. Pickup from 4Star for local orders (Eugene, Springfield, Corvallis and Salem). Delivery to Portland for $100.00.

Add cilantro to the recipe at the end of cooking or as a top dressing. You don't want to cook this herb as it will lose most of its flavor. If you are making pesto or sauce, you can grind the stems as well with a food processor.

products.name: Purple Radish
products.description: Purple radishes, often found as varieties like the purple daikon (Bora King, KN-Bravo), are crisp, mild, and slightly sweet root vegetables, commonly used raw in salads or pickled. They have violet skin with a white, purple-streaked interior, offering a crunchy texture and high levels of anthocyanins, antioxidants, Vitamin C, and fiber.

products.name: Dinner in a Box: Ground Lamb Bundle
products.description: Not sure what to make this week? Start here. This bundle is built around ground lamb from Deck Family Farm, paired with what's fresh right now: shiitake mushrooms, rainbow chard, beets, leeks, cabbage, potatoes, and pears. Add your yogurt and you've got a full week of dinners with no planning required. Lamb & Mushroom Skillet Brown 1 lb ground lamb with sliced shiitakes and a leek. Add garlic and a big handful of rainbow chard. Season with salt, pepper, red pepper flake. Stir in raw yogurt off the heat. Serve over roasted potatoes. 25 minutes for a rich, clean meal. Lamb-Stuffed Cabbage Rolls Blanch cabbage leaves, fill with seasoned ground lamb and sautéed onion, arrange in baking dish and simmer in a simple tomato broth. A classic — raw cream makes a great finish on top. Pear & Lamb Flatbread Spread raw yogurt on flatbread, add crumbled cooked lamb, sliced pear and beet, caramelized leeks, and your cheese pick from this week's dairy. Heat in the oven to melt the cheese. 15 minutes to assemble. TIPS : 1. Roast the potatoes while you prepare the rest. Add some beets for variety. 2. Brown all the lamb at once to simplify later meal prep. 3. Sauté all the leeks at once so you can add them easily later.

products.name: Dinner in a Box: Pork Shoulder Roast
products.description: Ingredients: Pork shoulder, potatoes, salad turnips, spring onions, beets, lettuce, radish, farmer's cheese, bok choy, garlic, eggs Recipe 1: Pulled Pork Tacos Warm tortillas, pile on pulled pork shoulder, sliced radish, shredded lettuce, and spring onion. Add a spoonful of farmer's cheese and a squeeze of lime. Done. Recipe 2: Pork & Bok Choy Soup: Simmer pulled pork in broth with garlic, spring onion, and sliced crimini mushrooms. Stir in a spoonful of whole grain mustard. Add bok choy in the last few minutes until just wilted. Finish with sesame oil and a soft-boiled egg. Recipe 3: Roasted Beet & Pork Bowl Roast beets until tender, slice thin. Arrange over torn lettuce with pulled pork, sliced radish, and spring onion. Top with crumbled farmer's cheese. Dress with olive oil, vinegar, and salt. Recipe 4: Pork & Potato Hash: Dice pulled pork shoulder. Cook with cubed potatoes, sliced crimini mushrooms, salad turnips, and spring onions in butter until golden. Season with salt and pepper. Top with a fried egg. products.description: Bok choy raab (also called bok choy rabe) isthe tender, flowering stalk that appears when overwintered or mature bok choy bolts in the spring. products.name: Garlic Scapes
products.description: Garlic scapes are the edible, curly flower stalks of hardneck garlic, harvested in late spring/early summer for a milder, sweeter garlic flavor than raw cloves, with a texture like asparagus or green beans. They are versatile and can be eaten raw (in pesto), sautéed, grilled, roasted, or blended into soups and sauces, often used as a substitute for garlic or scallions. To prepare, trim the woody ends and the flower bud, then cook them until tender, or use them raw in pesto.

products.description: Green pattypan squash isa small, saucer-shaped summer squash with distinct scalloped edges. Also called scallop squash or cymling, varieties like Benning's Green Tint feature tender pale-green skin, a mild and slightly nutty flavor, and a slightly firmer, meatier texture than standard zucchini.

products.name: Mixed Red and Yellow Peppers
products.description: Red and yellow sweet peppers are ripe, colorful bell peppers. They taste sweet and mild because they stay on the vine longer than green peppers. Red peppers are fully ripe and very sweet. Yellow peppers are also sweet and fruity. Both types add bright color and great flavor to food. Grown by: Red Tail

products.description: This organic coffee from Guatemala comes from our friends at OPTCO (Organic Products Trading Company). products.description: From our friends at Samaria Coffee Importers, this washed Colombian Coffee is produced by two sisters who inherited their fathers coffee farm. products.name: Stark Yellow Peaches
products.description: Flavor Profile: Bold and aromatic with a traditional, sharper peach tang backed by natural sugars. Appearance: Striking red blush over a sunny golden-yellow skin with a soft, fuzzy texture. Texture: Firm yet juicy golden flesh that delivers a classic stone-fruit bite. Best Uses: Ideal for fresh snacking, slicing into summer salads, or traditional baking and canning.

products.name: Black Gravenstein Apples
products.description: Black Gravenstein apples are a rare, heirloom variety featuring a uniquely dark, richly blushed red-and-green skin with crisp, juicy, and sharply tart-sweet flesh. Taste and Texture : Crisp and fine-grained flesh with a bold, tangy, sweet-tart flavor and a strong, sweet floral aroma. Best Uses : Exceptional for baking, making silky applesauce, pressing into cider, or slicing fresh for a tart snack.

products.name: Asian Pears
products.description: Asian pears are crisp, round, and sweet specialty fruits that crunch like an apple and offer a juicy, refreshing pear flavor Flavor : Delicately sweet with subtle honey, floral, or citrus notes, and low acidity.

products.name: Brooks Plums
products.description: Brooks plums are large, sweet, dark purple European prune plums featuring rich yellow flesh and exceptional versatility for fresh eating, canning, and drying.

products.name: Italian Plum
products.description: Italian plums are small, egg-shaped stone fruit with dark purple-black skin, a dusty natural "bloom" coating, and sweet-tart greenish-yellow flesh that easily pulls away from the pit. Flavor & Texture: Dense, firm flesh offering a balanced sweet-and-sour taste that turns juicy and vibrant fuchsia-pink when cooked.

products.name: Green Gage Plums
products.description: Green Gage plums are premium, honey-sweet European dessert fruits featuring a distinctive yellow-green skin and translucent, rich flesh. Flavor Profile: Exceptionally sweet and aromatic with complex notes of ripe mango, dried apricot, and honey. Texture: Succulent, dense, and juicy flesh with an easily removable freestone pit.

products.name: Fresh Frozen Elderberries
products.description: Raw or unripe elderberries contain natural compounds that can cause stomach upset and must always be cooked or thoroughly dried/heated before consumption. Flavor Profile: Deep, earthy, sweet, and tart when cooked or steeped. Key Uses: Perfect for simmering homemade immune syrups, blending into herbal teas, or baking into jams, jellies, and pies. Nutritional Benefits: Loaded with natural anthocyanins and powerful antioxidants that support year-round immune wellness. #3 bag of 2026 fresh frozen, cleaned, destemed, organic elderberries.

products.name: Frozen Raspberries
products.description: Raspberries, like other berries, provide vitamins, minerals, fiber, and antioxidants. The Raspberry flavor is defined as a green, acid and sweet natural profile. It evokes sensations of fresh juicy fruit with slightly crunchy floral undertones blended with woody notes taste at the end. Try them frozen and drizzled with Creamy Cow Sweet Cream!

products.name: Ground Beef & Pork Bundle
products.description: 2 lbs of Ground Beef and 2 lbs of Ground Pork.

products.name: Naravilla and Laturilla Figs
products.description: Figs are always Organic, these are vegan, not pollinated with fig wasps as in other regions because we do not have fig wasps here so they cross pollinate. Approximately 8 figs per pack.

products.name: Seckel Pears
products.description: The Seckel pear is a tiny, exceptionally sweet heirloom fruit often called the "sugar pear" or "candy pear". Flavor & Texture: Rich, spicy, and honeyed sweetness with firm, juicy, and smooth flesh. Perfect for kids and lunchboxes because of its bite-sized shape. Canning: Small enough to be canned or pickled whole. Cooking: Excellent for poaching, roasting, and pairing with cheese boards or desserts.

products.name: Satsuma plums
products.description: Satsuma plums are a variety of Japanese plum with a semi-clingstone texture and a rich, sweet flavor with a hint of tartness

products.name: Stanley Plums
products.description: a popular, self-fertile European prune-plum varietyknown for producing sweet, dark blue-purple oval fruits with golden-yellow flesh. Flavor: Very sweet and rich. products.name: Burbank Red Ace Plums
products.description: Fruit Quality: Big, firm, crimson-red skin with a green-yellow background and sweet, honey-flavored red flesh. Texture: Semi-freestone. Uses: Fresh eating, canning, and preserves.

products.name: Green Italian Frying Pepper
products.description: The Italian "friggi friggi" pepper is more commonly known as friggitelli , or Italian frying peppers. They are mild, small, and slender peppers native to southern Italy, prized for their sweet flavor and thin skin that makes them ideal for frying. The name comes from the Italian verb friggere , meaning "to fry". Friggitelli have a slightly sweet, fruity, and mild flavor, with a low heat level of 100–500 on the Scoville scale. Some varieties are entirely heatless. The taste can have a pleasant, slightly bitter edge.

products.name: Organic Spelt Flour
products.description: Spelt is a ancient variety of wheat with a low gluten content. Spelt flour has a mild and nutty flavor and is great for making cookies, muffins, scones, some breads and pasta.

products.name: Gold Beets
products.description: Golden beets are vibrant, yellow-orange root vegetables known for their mild, sweet flavor and less earthy taste than red beets, featuring bright yellow flesh that doesn't "bleed" color when cooked, making them visually appealing in salads, roasted dishes, and pickled. They have smooth, firm skin and offer similar nutrients to red beets, with edible greens that taste like spinach, providing versatility and a pop of color in many recipes.

products.name: Bavarian Style Grazier's Sausage
products.description: 🍁 A seasonal, European-style micro-batch celebrating the true flavor of the land. This spring, our pasture-raised pigs enjoyed an exceptionally lush, nutrient-dense diet of beets, radishes, kale, and fresh grass. In the world of regenerative farming, nature often surprises us—and this growing season yielded a beautiful, unexpected result: an incredibly rich, creamy, and delicate fat. When ground and mixed, this ultra-creamy fat naturally created a velvety, mousse-like emulsification with a light, airy texture. The result is a completely unique, premium sausage that is structurally identical to a traditional German Weisswurst or a delicate French boudin blanc. It offers a luxurious, melt-in-your-mouth bite rather than a dense, snappy grind. ✨ Why You’ll Love it • The Flavor: While the texture is lighter and more refined, the recipe is excellent. It features the exact same traditional, savory spice blend our customers crave. • True Terroir in Every Bite: Just like fine wine or artisan cheese, the flavor and texture of pasture-raised meat change with the seasons. This batch is a direct, tangible reflection of our rich spring pastures. • Exclusive Micro-Batch Pricing: Because of the surprising outcome, we want our community to benefit and are offering this limited run at a special introductory price. This is the ultimate culinary experience for foodies, sausage lovers, and anyone who wants to celebrate sustainable, transparent farming. Enjoy it gently poached, lightly pan-fried, or sliced into a comforting breakfast scramble. Ingredients: Pork, Pork Fat, Water, Dry Milk Powder, Less than 2% of Salt, dried vinegar, cultured dextrose, spice, Hog Casing. Contains: Milk

products.name: Bulk Hot Italian Sausage
products.description: Our Bulk Hot Italian Sausage is a bold, flavorful classic, packed with lightly crushed fennel, smoky paprika, and a nice spicy kick. This versatile sausage can elevate nearly any meal - add it to pasta, lasagna, top a pizza, or use in soups. With a spiciness level of 6/10, it delivers a balanced heat that enhances every bite. Ingredients: Pork, white wine, sea salt, fresh garlic, fennel, fresh parsley, fresh oregano, sugar, pepper, paprika, cayenne, crushed chile pepper.

products.description: Yellow Italian frying peppers are sweet, thin-skinned peppers—such as the golden Escamillo or Corno di Toro Giallo —that turn a brilliant bright yellow when ripe and soften into a rich, sweet flavor when cooked.

products.name: Turkish Long Eggplant
products.description: The Turkish long eggplant, famously known as the Kemer patlıcanı or varieties like Turkish Delight F1 , is a slender, deep purple, and mild-tasting squash-family vegetable prized for its tender texture and lack of bitterness.

products.name: Purple Top Turnip
products.description: Purple top turnips have a white, spherical root with a "purple crown" where the top is exposed above ground and is purple or magenta. They have a tender white flesh with a spicy flavor and large, lobed greens that are also edible and nutritious. This heirloom variety is easy to grow and commonly used for both human consumption and as a cool-weather forage for livestock and wildlife

products.name: Fuyu Persimmon
products.description: A good persimmon at its peak will taste sweet, mild, and rich. Many people have described its flavor as “honey-like.” Its texture is similar to that of an apricot and its skin is a bit tougher than an apple's.

products.name: Fresh Harvested Chestnuts
products.description: These are fresh, NOT dried chestnuts. Cure them by spreading them out at room temperature for 3 to 4 days to convert starches into natural sugars, enhancing sweetness. Cooking: Always cook and peel chestnuts before eating; never eat them raw straight off the tree due to high tannin content and tough texture. Score the outer shell and roast at 350°F for 25 minutes or steam them to make peeling easier.

products.name: Green Walnuts In Shell
products.description: They are good for bakers who want the appearance of the full walnut- they crack out of the shell much easier and you can keep them whole or in halves and bake them to dry. They require soaking, curing, or cooking to become palatable Liqueurs: They are world-famous for making Nocino in Italy or vin de noix in France by steeping the crushed green fruits in alcohol and sugar. Preserves & Pickles: They are widely used to make spiced pickled walnuts , sweet walnut jams, and traditional Greek spoon sweets ( glyko karydaki )
